user.title: AIS ONT Status
user.description: Connect to the restricted ONT Telnet menu and read optical RX/TX power.

data.rx_power_min_dbm: Minimum OK RX power in dBm

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure AIS ONT Status
reconfigure.description: Update the ONT Telnet connection settings. To re-enable LAN Telnet after a modem reboot, log in to the modem web UI, copy a fresh request Cookie header, and paste it below. The cookie is used once and is not stored.

data.rx_power_min_dbm: Minimum OK RX power in dBm

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the ONT Telnet menu.
error.invalid_auth: The ONT rejected the Telnet username or password.
error.enable_telnet_failed: The modem web request completed, but Telnet still is not usable. Paste a fresh Cookie header or use the manual DevTools fallback.
error.web_session_invalid: The modem rejected the temporary web session or the ACL token could not be found. Log in again and paste a fresh Cookie header.
